subject: Shiny Problem with SockJSAdapter - user issue?

messages.author: 54e59fe405f6add3
messages.subject: Shiny Problem with SockJSAdapter - user issue?
parts:
Dear Co-Users,

I ran into troubles:

On one server I have Shiny running. The Socket is started when needed using following command:

/usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R --no-save --slave -f /opt/shiny-server/R/SockJSAdapter.R



The other one on the same virtual machine on the other hand has problems starting shiny server, as the runtime Socket does abort with "su: Authentification failure". Interestingly, the command intializing the socket has the following syntax:

su -s /bin/bash --login -p -- someuser -c R --no-save --slave -f \/opt\/shiny-server\/R\/SockJSAdapter\.R


Could you please tell me where exactly can I alter these settings? New installation? Some config-file?


Thank you in advance


Yours

Waun Zel

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Problem with SockJSAdapter - user issue?
parts: The relevant config file should be /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf. I'd check for run_as directives as well as determining what user launches the shiny-server process (root vs. shiny).
